integrity: All polynomial identities and enumerations are over exact finite fields. Independent square-fiber enumeration crosschecks the F25 point count. Infinite extension formulas follow from Weil cohomology, not extrapolation. No independence or certified external verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the specified golden-ratio integral equation reduced at (5,phi-3); no claim about the whole nonreduced coefficient-base fiber, arbitrary integral models, positive-characteristic sextic node maxima, Picard rank or stable reduction. The 1996 original Barth article was not read in full; independent audit is not performed.
title: Maximal quadratic-extension reduction of Barth's sextic at the ramified prime five
